examples.english: International airfares are rising due to soaring fuel costs.

notes:
{航空|こうくう} means aviation or air travel. It functions primarily as a prefix in compound words rather than standing alone. Composed of ⟦{航|こう}→航：noentry⟧ (navigate) + ⟦{空|くう}→空：03949_kuu⟧ (sky).

COMPOUNDS:
- {航空|こうくう}⟦{会社|がいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧: airline
- {航空|こうくう}⟦{券|けん}→券：02150_ken⟧: airline ticket
- {航空|こうくう}⟦{便|びん}→便：noentry⟧: airmail, flight service
- {航空|こうくう}⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧: aircraft
- {航空|こうくう}⟦{運賃|うんちん}→運賃：05299_unchin⟧: airfare
- {航空|こうくう}⟦{自衛隊|じえいたい}→自衛隊：05790_jieitai⟧: Air Self-Defense Force

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧: airport
- ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧: airplane
- ⟦{飛行|ひこう}→飛行：03578_hikou⟧: flight

USAGE:
Japanese airline names typically end in {航空|こうくう}: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧{航空|こうくう} (JAL), ⟦{全日本|ぜんにほん}→全日本：noentry⟧⟦{空輸|くうゆ}→空輸：noentry⟧ (ANA, often abbreviated).
